content: Yihuda Kawa Iyo7aasa
Iyyuy, Isra7eele biittan kawotida laapuntho laythan, Iyo7aasi Yihudan kawotis; I Yerusalaamen oytamu laythi kawotis. Iya aaye sunthay Saabo; iya Barsaabe maccas.
Kahiney Yoodahey, iya tamaarsidanne zorida gisho, I de7ida laytha ubban Iyo7aasi Godaa sinthan suureba oothis.
Asay he bessan yarshonne ixaane cuyisethi aggiboonna gisho, dhoqa goyinno bessata dhaysibeenna.
Iyo7aasi kahineta xeegidi, “Xoossa keetha yaa geeshsha miishe ubbaa shiishite. Hessika huuphe taybuwa wode imetiya miishiyanne asay ba shenen Xoossa keethi ehiya miishiya.
Kahineti ubbay he miishiya ehiya asaape banta gishuwa gishuwa ekidi, Xoossa keetha giddon iitida ubbaa loythana” yaagis.
Shin kawoy Iyo7aasi kawotida laatamanne heedzantho laythi gakanaw, kahineti Xoossa keetha oorathibookona.

Kawoy Iyo7aasi kahiniya Yoodahenne hara kahineta xeegidi, “Xoossa keetha giddon iitida bessata ayis ooratheketii? Miishe Xoossa keetha oorathanaw immitepe attishin, hintew imetiya miishiya hinte kushen oykofite” yaagis.
Kahineti, “Asaape hara miishe ekoko; Xoossa keetha giddon iitida bessaa oorathana” yaagidi zaaridosona.

Yaatin, kahiniya Yoodahey issi saaxine ekidi, iya kamaa lukidi, yarsho bessa matan Xoossa keethi geliya pengiya ushacha baggara wothis. Pengiya naagiya kahineti Xoossa keetha yida miishiya ubbaa saaxiniyan yeggoosona.
Enti saaxiniyan daro miishey dagaayetidaysa be7ida wode ubban, kawo xaafeynne kahine halaqay yidi, miishiya taybidi, karxiitan qoloosona.
Taybetida miishiya salla7idaape guye, Xoossa keetha oosuwa xeellana mela sunthetida asaas immoosona. Enti miishiya ekidi, Xoossa keethan anaaxetasinne gimbeysati immoosona.
Miishiya shuchu masseysatasinne qoo7eysatas qanxanaw, Xoossa keetha oorathanaw, sanqa, shuchunne koshshiya harabata shammanaw go7etoosona.
Xoossa keetha yida miishiyape Xoossa keetha bira burcukota, qapheta, keretanne moyzeta woyko worqanne bira miisheta oothanaw kessibookona.
He miishe ubbay Xoossa keetha oorathiya asaas qanxetis.
Xoossa keetha oosuwa xeellanaw sunthetida asati ammanetida asi gidida gisho, “Miishiyan ay ay oothidetii?” yaagidi oychida asi oonika baawa.
Naaqo yarshonne nagara yarshos qanxetiya miishey kahinetas gelesipe attishin, Xoossa keetha oorathiya miishe saaxiniyan gelenna.
He wode Araame kawoy Azaheeli bidi, Gaate katama olidi oykis. Kaallidi Yerusalaame olanaw simmis.

Shin Yihuda kawoy Iyo7aasi iyape kase kawotida Yihuda kawoti Iyosaafexi, Iyoraaminne Akaziyaasi Godaas dummayida miisheta, ba imota, Xoossa keetha imotanne kawo gadho shalo minjiya bessan de7iya worqa ubba ekis. Araame kawas Azaheelas yeddin, Azaheeli Yerusalaame olanaw dendoysa aggaagis.
Kawoy Iyo7aasi hanida harabaynne I oothidaba ubbay Yihuda kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Hessafe guye, iya moorinnati iya bolla maqetidi, Siila efiya ogiyan Miilo geetetiya keethan wodhidosona.
Iya wodhida oosanchoti Sim7ata na7aa Yozakaaranne Shomeera na7aa Yozabaata. Iyo7aasi Dawita Kataman ba mayzata duufon moogetis; iya bessan iya na7ay Amasiyaasi kawotis.
